t: Din mi sheen lo ella tepilla achat
s: Din mi sheen lo ella tepilla achat ubo h' seipim: im en lo ella tepilla achat, ben shehi shel yad ben shehi shel rosh — meniach otah sheyyesh lo umebarek aleha, mippene shekkol achat mitzva bipne atzmah veen meakkebot zo et zo:
Vehu haddin im yesh lo shettehen ella sheyyesh lo shum ones sheeno yakol lehaniach raq achat mehen — meniach otah sheyyakol umebarek aleha:

Hammashkim latzet badderek im shayyara veen hashshayyara mamtenet alayv veeno yakol lehitakkeb kede lehaniach tepillin shel yad — meniach tepillin shel rosh lebad, sheen bahanachato shehut kol kak. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyihyeh yakol lehaniach achar-kak gam tepillin shel yad, abal im lo yihyeh yakol achar-kak lehaniach tepillin shel yad — tzarik lehaniach akshav qodem halikato mibbeto tepillin shel yad utepillin shel rosh, demishshum ichur darko lo hittiru lo lebattel mitzvat tepillin:
Im eno meniach ella tepillin shel rosh lebad — mebarek aleha shette berakot: "lehaniach tepillin" ve"al mitzvat tepillin", kemo shennitbaer hattaam besiman kah:

Im eno meniach ella tepillin shel yad bilbad — eno mebarek ella "lehaniach tepillin" lebad. Veyesh omerim sheapillu eno meniach ella tepillin shel rosh lebad — eno mebarek ella "al mitzvat tepillin" lebad. Ukebar nitbaer besiman kah dehamminhag beellu haaratzot kassebara harishona:
